records.jp: これもさっきのと同じ。<CR>二人のフラグメントの破片が、想いに包まれてる
records.en_original: It's just like before. The shard of their Fragment is wrapped in emotions.
records.en: It's just like before. The shard of their Fragment is wrapped in emotions.

records.jp: けど、パイプオルガンって誰だろう……。<CR>陽桜莉は心当たりある？
records.en_original: But whose feelings would revolve around a pipe organ? Do you have any idea, Hiori?
records.en: But whose feelings would revolve around a pipe organ? Do you have any idea, Hiori?

records.jp: うーん、多分この教会に関係ある人だと思うけど、<CR>だとすると……
records.en_original: Hmm, maybe someone related to this church? But if that's the case...
records.en: Hmm, maybe someone related to this church? But if that's the case...

records.jp: ……まさか、あの人の想いだったりしない？
records.en_original: Wait, could it be who I think it is?
records.en: Wait, could it be who I think it is?

records.jp: 誰のかはライムたちもわからないけど、<CR>とにかく早く触れてみて
records.en_original: Can't say I know for sure either, so just hurry up and touch it.
records.en: Can't say I know for sure either, so just hurry up and touch it.

records.jp: 生ぬるくて気持ち悪い世界
records.en_original: A lukewarm and disgusting world.
records.en: A lukewarm and disgusting world.

records.jp: 友情や愛による繋がり。<CR>それは誰しもが求めるもの
records.en_original: A world where everyone seeks connections through friendship and love.
records.en: A world where everyone seeks connections through friendship and love.

records.jp: けれど、私は何も感じられなかった
records.en_original: But I felt none of that.
records.en: But I felt none of that.

records.jp: 私にとっては幻でしかないそれを求める世界は、<CR>気持ち悪いものにしか感じられなかった
records.en_original: In a world consumed with nothing more than illusory comforts, all I felt was revulsion.
records.en: In a world consumed with nothing more than illusory comforts, all I felt was revulsion.

records.jp: 世界がそれを認めている以上、<CR>異質なのは私に違いない
records.en_original: But since they're all fine with the sham, they label me as the one who's different.
records.en: But since they're all fine with the sham, they label me as the one who's different.

records.jp: 何も感じられない私は、この世界に存在していないも<CR>同然の存在だった……
records.en_original: Someone who's unable to feel anything like me is as good as dead to everyone else.
records.en: Someone who's unable to feel anything like me is as good as dead to everyone else.

records.jp: けれど、私はようやく知ることができた
records.en_original: But I finally realized something.
records.en: But I finally realized something.

records.jp: この世で信じられるのは、そう……
records.en_original: The only thing you can trust in this world...
records.en: The only thing you can trust in this world...

records.jp: 痛みだけだと！
records.en_original: ...is pain and nothing else!
records.en: ...is pain and nothing else!

records.jp: 痛みこそ実存。<CR>虚飾を排した純粋な自己
records.en_original: To feel pain is to exist—the pure self stripped of all pretense.
records.en: To feel pain is to exist—the pure self stripped of all pretense.

records.jp: 痛みのない世界、友情や愛の繋がりに重きを置く世界。<CR>そんなのつまらない！
records.en_original: A world without pain, a world that values the bonds of friendship and love? How boring!
records.en: A world without pain, a world that values the bonds of friendship and love? How boring!

records.jp: 痛みはこんなにも気持ちいいんですから！
records.en_original: Pain is the ultimate bliss, after all!
records.en: Pain is the ultimate bliss, after all!

records.jp: 痛みを感じること、痛みを知ること。<CR>それこそが、私にとっての生きる意味！
records.en_original: To feel pain, to know pain—that's the meaning of life for me!
records.en: To feel pain, to know pain—that's the meaning of life for me!

records.jp: だから、ああ……紫乃たん……。<CR>紫乃たんの抱えてる痛みを、早く知りたい……
records.en_original: That's why I want to know what pain burdens Shino as soon as possible.
records.en: That's why I want to know what pain burdens Shino as soon as possible.

records.jp: 誰よりも悪を軽蔑しているのに、<CR>大勢のフラグメントを、容赦なく抜き取る紫乃たん
records.en_original: Even though she despises evil more than anyone, Shino mercilessly steals away Fragments.
records.en: Even though she despises evil more than anyone, Shino mercilessly steals away Fragments.

records.jp: それがどういうことか理解しながら、一切の痛みも<CR>罪悪感も抱かずに粛々と行える紫乃たん……
records.en_original: She knows exactly what the outcome will be, yet she does it with no regret or guilt...
records.en: She knows exactly what the outcome will be, yet she does it with no regret or guilt...

records.jp: それだけ心の底から自分を正しいと思えるなんて……、<CR>きっと、相当の痛みを経験したんでしょうね？
records.en_original: To have such conviction when doing something so monstrous...surely she must have gone through some serious pain!
records.en: To have such conviction when doing something so monstrous...surely she must have gone through some serious pain!

records.jp: 紫乃たんの創ろうとしている感情のない世界。<CR>そんなものには一切興味は持てないけれど……
records.en_original: I don't care one bit about the emotionless world Shino wants to create...
records.en: I don't care one bit about the emotionless world Shino wants to create...

records.jp: 紫乃たんがどんな壮絶な痛みを経験したのか。<CR>それを知れるなら、いくらでも協力は惜しみません
records.en_original: But if I can learn about the overwhelming pain that consumes her, there are no lengths I won't go to help her.
records.en: But if I can learn about the overwhelming pain that consumes her, there are no lengths I won't go to help her.

records.jp: けど……
records.en_original: But...
records.en: But...

records.jp: もし、そんなつまらない世界の方が先に<CR>実現しそうになったら
records.en_original: If that boring world of hers ever looks like it's about to come about before I do...
records.en: If that boring world of hers ever looks like it's about to come about before I do...

records.jp: その時は、紫乃たんを――
records.en_original: Then, at that moment, I'll—
records.en: Then, at that moment, I'll—

records.jp: ……ヤバい人とは思ってたけど、<CR>これは想像以上ね
records.en_original: I thought she was bad news, but this is way beyond what I imagined.
records.en: I thought she was bad news, but this is way beyond what I imagined.

records.jp: 詩ちゃんにとっては、紫乃ちゃんすら<CR>歪んだ快楽を得るための存在でしかない
records.en_original: To Uta, even Shino is nothing more than someone she uses to fulfill her twisted desires.
records.en: To Uta, even Shino is nothing more than someone she uses to fulfill her twisted desires.

records.jp: そのためなら、自分が最も嫌う世界を創る計画にも<CR>協力するなんて……本当、この子だけはわからない
records.en_original: She'd even help bring about a world she hates for a reason like that? Seriously, she's impossible to figure out.
records.en: She'd even help bring about a world she hates for a reason like that? Seriously, she's impossible to figure out.

records.jp: けど、本気なのはよくわかった。<CR>こんなに強い想い、今まで感じたことがないもの
records.en_original: But I can tell she's serious. I've never felt emotions this strong before.
records.en: But I can tell she's serious. I've never felt emotions this strong before.

records.jp: 何があろうとブレない、まっすぐな想い。<CR>そこだけは、私たちも見習うべきなのかもしれない
records.en_original: Unwavering feelings, no matter what the outcome. Maybe that's something we should learn from, too.
records.en: Unwavering feelings, no matter what the outcome. Maybe that's something we should learn from, too.

records.jp: 私……間違ってたかも
records.en_original: I might have been wrong.
records.en: I might have been wrong.

records.jp: 詩ちゃんとも、しっかり話す機会が欲しいと思ってた。<CR>そうすれば、きっとわかってくれるって
records.en_original: I've wanted a chance to speak with Uta, too. I thought that if we could just talk to her, she'd understand.
records.en: I've wanted a chance to speak with Uta, too. I thought that if we could just talk to her, she'd understand.

records.jp: けど……詩ちゃんは、違う気がする。<CR>ただ話し合おうっていっても、無駄な気がする
records.en_original: But I'm not sure Uta would listen like the others. Trying to reason with her alone probably won't do any good.
records.en: But I'm not sure Uta would listen like the others. Trying to reason with her alone probably won't do any good.

records.jp: ……話せる相手じゃない、ってこと？
records.en_original: So you're saying she's not someone we can reason with?
records.en: So you're saying she's not someone we can reason with?

records.jp: 私たちの方がそう思われてるんだよ。<CR>だから、認めてもらわないといけないんだと思う
records.en_original: She probably thinks the same way about us. That's why we need to show her she's wrong.
records.en: She probably thinks the same way about us. That's why we need to show her she's wrong.

records.jp: 詩ちゃんを傷つけてでも話を聞いてほしいっていう、<CR>詩ちゃんが生きる意味への誠意を見せて……
records.en_original: Even if we have to hurt Uta to get through to her, we need to show her our sincerity about what makes life worth living.
records.en: Even if we have to hurt Uta to get through to her, we need to show her our sincerity about what makes life worth living.

records.jp: 陽桜莉……
records.en_original: Hiori...
records.en: Hiori...

records.jp: 変なこと言ってごめん、瑠夏ちゃん
records.en_original: Sorry for saying something so weird, Ruka.
records.en: Sorry for saying something so weird, Ruka.

records.jp: ううん、そんなことない。<CR>行こう
records.en_original: Don't be. You're not being weird at all. Let's go.
records.en: Don't be. You're not being weird at all. Let's go.

records.jp: 内容はどうあれ、あの強い想いは<CR>今の二人にいい影響になったと思う
records.en_original: Whatever just happened between them, those strong emotions probably influenced both of them in a positive way.
records.en: Whatever just happened between them, those strong emotions probably influenced both of them in a positive way.

records.jp: ここに来た目的を忘れてる二人が、<CR>想いをブレさせない強さについて考えてくれた……
records.en_original: They've forgotten their reason for coming here, but they're gaining the strength to have unwavering feelings.
records.en: They've forgotten their reason for coming here, but they're gaining the strength to have unwavering feelings.

records.jp: ほんの少しでも、ここに来た本当の目的について<CR>考えなおしてくれたらいいんだけど
records.en_original: I hope they start remembering the real reason they're here, though.
records.en: I hope they start remembering the real reason they're here, though.
